title: Pangea
tagline: first hackathon + shipped dao and dap + built with thirdweb.
description: this was a test of buildspace + thirdwebs dev tools and guides. my idea is to create a dao that does monthly charity donations to random charities around the world in hopes of bringing the world back together. i used replit w node and alchemy to create a member nft , governance token and dao. once testing i over and done with will migrate to polygon.
